1. promptable segmentation task — new task definition; differs from existing interactive segmentation (E025: interactive segmentation aims to eventually predict valid mask after enough user input; ours aims to always predict valid mask for any prompt even ambiguous) and from multi-task segmentation systems (E030).
2. SAM model: image encoder + prompt encoder + mask decoder, ambiguity-aware multi-mask output, ~50ms in browser CPU (E012, E042, E043, E044).
3. Data engine + SA-1B dataset: 1.1B masks, 11M images, 400× more masks than any existing segmentation dataset (E014), 99.1% fully automatic (E056), verified quality 94% >90 IoU (E057).
